Our powerful multilingual ASR captures speech with precision, while advanced NLP uncovers real intent, emotion, and meaning across every interaction. From quality checks and agent performance monitoring to deep customer analytics, Lingo transforms unstructured voice and text data into actionable insights—fueling better decisions, improved service, and measurable business outcomes. See More See More Agent Studio SandLogic Agent Studio is a powerful no-code/low-code platform that lets you design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents tailored for your business workflows. With an intuitive visual interface, you can configure agents using Shakti LLMs or open-source models like Llama and Mistral, define custom tools, manage context-aware memory, and connect to your APIs — all without writing heavy code. Whether you're creating internal copilots, automation bots, or customer-facing assistants, Agent Studio empowers teams to launch scalable, domain-specific agents with precision. Integrated testing, live debugging, and one-click deployment to web, chat, or voice channels make it enterprise-ready and developer-friendly. Follow us on LinkedIn for updates Follow us on LinkedIn for updates Bot Studio SandLogic Bots Studio is a streamlined platform for creating and managing task-specific bots that automate conversations, actions, and workflows across your organization. Designed for speed and simplicity, Bots Studio allows teams to build lightweight bots using predefined templates, modular logic blocks, and Shakti LLM-powered responses. Whether it’s automating FAQs, scheduling meetings, handling support tickets, or triggering backend APIs, Bots Studio offers a plug-and-play experience with real-time testing, version control, and multi-channel deployment.
